title: Mavie's 3rd Birthday Party Gathers Family and Draws Attention with Beyoncé Look
seoTitle: Mavie's 3rd Birthday Party: Beyoncé Look & Celebs
subtitle: The celebration for Mavie, daughter of Neymar and Bruna Biancardi, stood out due to Helena's outfit and the presence of famous guests
excerpt: Mavie's 3rd birthday party, daughter of Neymar and Bruna Biancardi, took place in São Paulo with a 'Talent Show' theme, featuring celebrities and the look.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The 3rd birthday party of Mavie, daughter of Neymar and Bruna Biancardi, was held this Tuesday (6) in São Paulo and made headlines for two reasons: the presence of several famous guests and the Beyoncé-inspired look worn by Helena, Neymar's daughter with Amanda Kimberlly.

Details of the celebration and guests

The event, themed "Mavie's Talent Show," took place at the Festa na Cachola buffet in Moema. The venue was equipped with children's attractions, such as a zip line, a ball pit, slides, and a soccer field. The decoration followed the lilac tone of the party, featuring dessert tables and details reminiscent of friendship bracelets.

Among the guests were Tata Estaniecki, Duda Siebert, Roberto Justus's daughter, Vick, Neymar's parents – Nadine and Neymar Sr. – and his sister Rafaella. Athletes like Coutinho, Rodinei, and Gabigol also attended, accompanied by their children.

Helena's scene-stealing look

Helena, Neymar's daughter with Amanda Kimberlly, appeared wearing an outfit inspired by one of Beyoncé's most iconic looks. The outfit included a bubblegum pink sweatshirt, boots covered in multicolored sequins, and the soles of the boots painted red.

Amanda Kimberlly herself shared that she customized the outfit: she dyed the sweatshirt, added a custom printed sticker, and transformed the boots with sequins and painted soles. She described her daughter as part of a "Little Beyhive," a reference to the singer's fan community.

Moments captured by Bruna Biancardi

On Instagram, Bruna Biancardi posted photos of the family singing "Happy Birthday" and a rare picture alongside Helena. The images showed the family gathered together, with Mavie, Mel (1 year old), and the parents coordinating the lilac look of the party.

Expectatives for the family

In addition to the celebration, Bruna Biancardi revealed that the family is awaiting the arrival of the third daughter, Mariah, further expanding the family unit.

With information from Gshow, CNN Brasil.
